add_historical_topic_added_variable_effect = { 
	scope:reader ?= { 
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = historical_topic_added } }
			set_variable = { name = historical_topic_added value = 1 }
		}
		else = { change_variable = { name = historical_topic_added add = 1 } }
	}
}

GH_create_library_topic_effect = {
	set_variable = { 
		name = recently_checked_collection
		value = yes
		years = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = list_of_available_topics target = flag:gh_warfare_topic } }
			scope:gh_location_ruler.location ?= { has_building_with_flag = has_martial_topic_in_library }
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = list_of_available_topics
			target = flag:gh_warfare_topic
		}
		add_historical_topic_added_variable_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = list_of_available_topics target = flag:gh_magic_topic } }
			scope:gh_location_ruler.location ?= { has_building_with_flag = has_arcana_topic_in_library } 
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = list_of_available_topics
			target = flag:gh_magic_topic
		}
		add_historical_topic_added_variable_effect = yes
	}

gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = gh_available_books_in_$SELECTED_TOPIC$_list } }
		gh_choose_region_for_book_list_for_topic_effect = { VALUE = gh_remaining_location_topic_book_capacity_value SELECTED_TOPIC = $SELECTED_TOPIC$ }
		set_variable = { name = book_list_initialized value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 
			NOT = { has_variable = recently_checked_collection  }
			gh_post_creation_remaining_location_book_capacity_value > 1 # 1 instead of 0 because small variations are not taken into account; it could just be randomness
		}
		gh_choose_region_for_book_list_for_topic_effect = { VALUE = gh_post_creation_remaining_location_book_capacity_value SELECTED_TOPIC = $SELECTED_TOPIC$ }
	}
}

gh_select_topic_for_book_list_creation_effect = {
	$READER$ = { save_scope_as = reader }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_theology_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_theology_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_law_and_governance_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_law_and_governance_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_warfare_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_warfare_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_philosophy_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_philosophy_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_magic_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_magic_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_language_and_letters_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_language_and_letters_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_history_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_history_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_mathematics_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_mathematics_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_cosmology_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_cosmology_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_natural_sciences_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_natural_sciences_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_medicine_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_medicine_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_practical_arts_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_practical_arts_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_commerce_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_commerce_topic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_literature_topic } }
		gh_create_book_list_for_topic_effect = { SELECTED_TOPIC = gh_literature_topic }
	}
}

gh_remove_book_from_collection_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_theology_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_theology_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_law_and_governance_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_law_and_governance_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_warfare_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_warfare_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_philosophy_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_philosophy_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_magic_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_magic_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_language_and_letters_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_language_and_letters_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_history_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_history_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_mathematics_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_mathematics_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_cosmology_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_cosmology_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_natural_sciences_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_natural_sciences_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_medicine_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_medicine_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_practical_arts_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_practical_arts_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_commerce_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_commerce_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:actor ?= { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_literature_topic } }
		remove_list_variable = {
			name = gh_available_books_in_gh_literature_topic_list
			target = scope:actor.var:gh_attempt_to_buy_book_in_collection
		}
	}
}


create_available_book_in_list_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = gh_maximum_number_of_regional_books_in_topic
		value = number_of_$REGION$_$TOPIC$_value
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = gh_maximum_number_of_general_books_in_topic
		value = number_of_general_$TOPIC$_value
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = number_of_existing_book_in_topic_location_value_scope
		value = number_of_existing_book_in_$TOPIC$_location_value
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = book_list_initialized }
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = number_of_books_with_increased_rarity_value_scope
			value = number_of_books_with_increased_rarity_value
		}
	}

	add_historical_book_artifact_to_libraries_effect = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ }
	while = {
		count = $VALUE$
		random_list = {

			# REGIONAL BOOKS
			300 = {

gh_transfer_procedural_book_to_library = {
	$COLLECTOR$ = { save_scope_as = gh_collector_procedural }

	# We want to make sure the topic exists before trying to add to its list
	gh_add_topic_to_collection_effect = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ }

	scope:gh_collector_procedural.location.var:gh_search_library_story ?= { #ASKIL NOTE: If collections should be county-based, change value here
		gh_select_topic_for_book_list_creation_effect = { READER = scope:gh_collector_procedural }
	}

	# We find a flag that hasn't been used to store book information
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = procedural_book_flag_1 } }
		create_procedural_book_attribute_story = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ BOOK_FLAG = procedural_book_flag_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = procedural_book_flag_2 } }
		create_procedural_book_attribute_story = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ BOOK_FLAG = procedural_book_flag_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = procedural_book_flag_3 } }
		create_procedural_book_attribute_story = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ BOOK_FLAG = procedural_book_flag_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = procedural_book_flag_4 } }
		create_procedural_book_attribute_story = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ BOOK_FLAG = procedural_book_flag_4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = procedural_book_flag_5 } }
		create_procedural_book_attribute_story = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ BOOK_FLAG = procedural_book_flag_5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = procedural_book_flag_6 } }
		create_procedural_book_attribute_story = { TOPIC = $TOPIC$ BOOK_FLAG = procedural_book_flag_6 }
	}

gh_add_topic_book_bonus_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_theology_topic }
		add_gh_theology_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_law_and_governance_topic }
		add_gh_law_and_governance_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_warfare_topic }
		add_gh_warfare_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_philosophy_topic }
		add_gh_philosophy_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_magic_topic }
		add_gh_magic_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_language_and_letters_topic }
		add_gh_language_and_letters_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_history_topic }
		add_gh_history_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_mathematics_topic }
		add_gh_mathematics_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_cosmology_topic }
		add_gh_cosmology_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_natural_sciences_topic }
		add_gh_natural_sciences_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_medicine_topic }
		add_gh_medicine_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_practical_arts_topic }
		add_gh_practical_arts_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_commerce_topic }
		add_gh_commerce_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_literature_topic }
		add_gh_literature_topic_bonus_effect = yes
	}
}


GH_select_topic_for_random_ke_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_theology_topic }
		add_gh_theology_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_law_and_governance_topic }
		add_gh_law_and_governance_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_warfare_topic }
		add_gh_warfare_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_philosophy_topic }
		add_gh_philosophy_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {

		add_gh_magic_topic_ke_effect = yes

	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_language_and_letters_topic }
		add_gh_language_and_letters_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_history_topic }
		add_gh_history_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_mathematics_topic }
		add_gh_mathematics_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_cosmology_topic }
		add_gh_cosmology_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_natural_sciences_topic }
		add_gh_natural_sciences_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_medicine_topic }
		add_gh_medicine_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_practical_arts_topic }
		add_gh_practical_arts_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_commerce_topic }
		add_gh_commerce_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:reader.var:gh_chosen_topic ?= flag:gh_literature_topic }
		add_gh_literature_topic_ke_effect = yes
	}
